messages:
alice: Heads-up — planning a controlled enable of model 'sapphire-3b-q4' in the catalog (hosted + dedicated). Target change window Thu 02:00-04:00 PST. Need SRE + Prod signoff. Outline below.

ben_dev: Quick Q — what's the intended fallback ordering? want to ensure quantized variants don't become the default for high-quality routes.

charu_ml: Proposal: prefer fp16 primary, q4 as low-cost fallback, legacy 2.7 last. For latency-sensitive routes we'll flip priority to favor q4. Example config below.

charu_ml: ```yaml
fallbacks:
  - model: sapphire-3b
    priority: 100
  - model: sapphire-3b-q4
    priority: 80
  - model: sapphire-2.7
    priority: 50
```

deploy-bot: Deployment schedule created by deploy-bot:
- Canary: 2% at 02:10
- Ramp: 2% -> 20% over 60m (step ramping)
- Full: 100% target at 03:40 if no alerts
Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency +30% vs baseline over 5m.

david_prod: Also need a pin: enterprise customers should remain pinned to sapphire-2.7 for compatibility and compliance. Can someone add that to the pinlist before full rollout?

erin_pm: Copy — I'll notify support and author release notes. Adding communication to the status page. :speaker_with_three_sound_waves:

charu_ml: QA gate: run eval harness on production-weighted prompt set. Quality rollback threshold: rouge-L drop > 2.0 pts OR generation divergence > 0.025 cosine delta -> manual rollback.

sre_oncall: I'll own oncall during the window. I'll spin up a Datadog dashboard, add smoke alerts, and watch the canary. Also enabling canary autoscaling bump (+1 GPU headroom) for the first 30m.

ben_dev: Suggest adding a fallback-usage TTL rule: if any fallback model receives >10% of traffic for 15m, trigger a P0 alert to pause rollout. Small config snippet:

ben_dev: ```yaml
fallback_usage_watch:
  threshold_pct: 10
  window_minutes: 15
  action: pause_rollout + notify_oncall
```

alice: Approved that TTL rule. Added to release checklist.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 02:10 — 2% traffic -> sapphire-3b-q4. Initial logs: no elevated 5xx in first 10m.

charu_ml: Running eval harness now against the prod prompt set, will post numbers in ~10m.

charu_ml: Eval results: rouge-L -0.9 (within gate), p95 latency +12% (within latency gate), embedding cosine diff 0.002. Approving ramp to 20%.

deploy-bot: Ramped to 20% at 02:50. No alerts firing.

alice: Good. Approving continue-to-full. @david_prod please confirm enterprise pin applied before we go full.

david_prod: Pin applied: enterprise -> sapphire-2.7. Verified via console (pin id: pin_2024_07_08_enterprise).

deploy-bot: Ramped to 100% at 03:42. Final canary metrics: global 5xx 0.07%, p95 latency +11% vs baseline, fallback usage 3.2%. No auto-rollbacks triggered.

erin_pm: Release notes drafted and posted: https://redwood/docs/releases/2024-07-sapphire-3b — includes migration notes and fallback behavior. Will ping customers in the morning. :tada:

sre_oncall: I'll keep 24h smoke monitoring. No regressions observed in first 3h. Reopen thread if anything looks odd.

alice: Thanks all — closing this rollout. Action items: charu_ml to run overnight eval, ben_dev to add the fallback-usage metric to alerts dashboard, erin_pm will send customer note tomorrow morning.

ben_dev: noted.

deploy-bot: Deployment closed by deploy-bot at 03:45. Logs stored at /deploys/2024/07/08/sapphire-3b-q4.

erin_pm: Linking post-deploy checklist here for reference: https://redwood/ops/release-checklists/catalog-enable-gated

charu_ml: Posting overnight eval link once complete.

sre_oncall: If anyone needs the dashboard or runbook, ping me and I'll share perms.
